 Wearables and health Garmin Instinct 3 Solar drops $160 to its lowest Amazon price
 Garmin's rugged 50mm Instinct 3 Solar is 36% off, with up to 40 days of battery and unlimited smartwatch life in enough sun. Matt Horne • Nov 18, 2026 — 10:52 AM ET 
 • • Ryan Haines / Android Authority Add Android Authority on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Garmin’s rugged everyday watch has never been cheaper on Amazon. The Garmin Instinct 3 Solar in the 50mm size is down to $289.99 on Amazon , $160 off its $449.99 list price, or 36% off. That’s the lowest price Amazon has ever charged for it.
 Battery life is the headline feature. Garmin rates the 50mm model for up to 40 days in smartwatch mode, and the solar charging lens can keep it going indefinitely with about three hours of strong sunlight a day. GPS tracking is rated for up to 60 hours, or 260 hours with solar help, which suits long hikes and multi-day trips.
 It’s built for that kind of use, with a metal-reinforced bezel and a built-in LED flashlight for campsites and early-morning runs. Multi-band GPS with SatIQ picks the best satellite mode automatically to balance accuracy and battery life.
 Health and training tools are well covered too. You get pulse ox tracking, sleep score, Training Readiness, and daily suggested workouts, plus Garmin Pay so you can tap to pay when you leave your wallet at home.
 The Garmin Instinct 3 Solar holds a 4.6-star rating on Amazon. At $289.99, it’s a great fit for hikers, runners, and anyone who’s tired of charging a watch every night.
